name: Guardian genius crossword No 251
preamble: Chain 1 Bad time in pursuit of flex or chain Chain not right for Frankfurt? Remains sheltered by two lecturers in conflict, a source of vision in dark times More than one place in the country not opening Looking to miss a train Solution for Two chains of words run from * to &, and from # to %, with some running upwards or right-to-left as necessary. Each chain is clued in the order of its answers, which should be fitted in where they will go, using the answers to the other clues as guides. Each chain exhibits a common feature that will help placement even if not all clues in the chain have been solved.
